inference_contract.component_definition: frozen full C00 at float32 0.719 and frozen all-size topology
inference_contract.new_features: within-frame and within-video relative ranks and frame-to-maximum values

guard.fit_weighting: equal total positive mass per fit source
guard.family_ensemble: maximum support over independently fitted source-family positive models

calibration_and_selection.inner_predictions: each F1-F4 family is predicted only by positive models fitted on each of the other three families
calibration_and_selection.numeric_cutoff: minimum inner-OOF support of all positive components, or identity
calibration_and_selection.winner: highest pooled official inner-OOF Score among candidates passing every-family safety gates
calibration_and_selection.outer_prediction: maximum support over four family-specific models, none fitted on F5

safety_gates.smoke_success: selected nonidentity candidate deletes both false-positive events and false components on F5 with every safety gate true

stop_rule: do not expand to five-family OOF if the F5 diagnostic has no safe nonidentity gain
